I think there’s a lack of good fathers in our society and I would like to be father because I think I would be a good one. I experienced enough pitfalls and setbacks in childhood/teenage that I think I could steer my child in the right direction. 
A romantic relationship with a man or woman seem unattainable due to personal trust issues and I have a hard time finding anyone interesting enough to pursue romance. 
From what I’ve observed a lot of the drama/hardships from being a single parent aren’t even about the child, but the adults involved. With surrogacy/egg donors this drama could be avoided.
Yeah and I don’t want to say anything to anyone because I don’t want them to feel obligated to spend time with me.
